author: ValWood
body:
I'm not sure 

GO:0008660 | 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase activity | IEA with 16933

Is found in yeast, since " 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate" appears to be a plant metabolite

I'm happy to be corrected on this but the pombe gene with this annotation is also annotated to

GO:0019148 | D-cysteine desulfhydrase activity
 In plants, it seems to have both activities.

The PAINT annotation is to GO:0019148 | D-cysteine desulfhydrase activity
